# Compare the low flows (Q95) of the Seine at Paris and the Loire at Blois.

**Low‑flow (Q95) comparison**

| River / Gauge | Station (source / ID) | Record period | Length (years) | Q95 (m³ s⁻¹) |
|---------------|----------------------|--------------|----------------|--------------|
| Seine – Paris (Austerlitz) | hubeau_hydrometrie / F700000102 | 1990‑01‑01 → 2026‑03‑16 | ≈ 36 yr | 93 m³ s⁻¹ |
| Loire – Blois | hubeau_hydrometrie / K447001001 | 1900‑01‑01 → 2026‑09‑17* | ≈ 127 yr | 60 m³ s⁻¹ |

\*The catalog lists the station from 1863‑01‑01, but the Hub’Eau record supplied starts on 1900‑01‑01.

**Interpretation (data‑only)**  
- The Seine at Paris has a higher 95 % low‑flow discharge (93 m³ s⁻¹) than the Loire at Blois (60 m³ s⁻¹).  
- Both values come from flow‑duration‑curve analysis of daily mean discharge (Hub’Eau, licence etalab‑2.0).  
- The Loire gauge benefits from a much longer record (≈ 127 yr) than the Seine gauge (≈ 36 yr), which generally improves confidence in its low‑flow estimate.  

**Additional low‑flow metric (optional)**  
- 7‑day‑mean low flow (7Q10) is 77 m³ s⁻¹ for the Seine and 40 m³ s⁻¹ for the Loire, showing the same relative ordering.  

All numbers are directly taken from the low‑flow context outputs for the two stations. No other site information is introduced.

## Methods and citations

1. **Flow-duration curve.** Empirical exceedance probabilities of daily flow (Weibull plotting positions); Q95 and Q10 read from the curve. _Vogel, R. M., & Fennessey, N. M. (1994). Flow-duration curves I: new interpretation and confidence intervals. J. Water Resour. Plann. Manage., 120(4), 485-504._
2. **Baseflow index (Lyne-Hollick filter).** Recursive digital filter (alpha 0.925, three passes); the index is the baseflow volume over the total. _Lyne, V., & Hollick, M. (1979). Stochastic time-variable rainfall-runoff modelling. Inst. Eng. Aust. Natl. Conf. Publ. 79/10, 89-93._
3. **Low-flow frequency (7Q10).** Annual minima of the 7-day mean flow ranked by the Weibull plotting position; the 10-year value read from the curve. _Smakhtin, V. U. (2001). Low flow hydrology: a review. J. Hydrol. 240, 147-186._
